name: KinFlo adapter switch evidence matrix
objective: Prove every fixture-to-live adapter surface has generated API coverage, ordered smoke evidence, rollback posture, design-quality gates, and human approval blockers before any live switch can be considered.

providerBoundary.notes: This matrix reads existing local contracts only. It does not create a hosted deployment, run codegen, import convex/_generated/api, execute hosted Convex, call providers, or expose secrets.

sources.name: Webby Awards 2026 Websites and Mobile Sites winners
sources.signal: Top sites combine clear first-screen identity, disciplined interaction, data visualization, and editorial-grade proof surfaces.

sources.name: UX Design Awards winners
sources.signal: Award-caliber products document usability, accessibility, user value, and system fit instead of relying on visual polish alone.

sources.name: Awwwards SaaS inspiration
sources.signal: Modern SaaS pages use sharp hierarchy, product specificity, and polished responsive states.

sources.name: SaaS UI design trends 2026
sources.signal: Current SaaS patterns favor calmer dashboards, AI-native workflows, command surfaces, and strategic minimalism.

sources.name: Muzli dashboard examples 2026
sources.signal: Strong dashboards prioritize hierarchy, scan speed, dense but legible data, and low visual noise.

appliedCriteria: first-screen signal: the active site, tenant, or launch object is immediately visible
calm operational density: tables, controls, and evidence are compact but readable
configuration clarity: users can see what they can configure, what is gated, and why
proof before publish: every launch surface shows evidence, blockers, rollback, and owner
responsive inspection: desktop and mobile states must be reviewable before client handoff
restrained motion and polish: motion supports orientation without obscuring status or action
accessibility and state clarity: disabled, blocked, review, go, and no-go states are explicit

claudeCodeFrameReview.lastLocalCheck: Claude Code CLI installed, but the credential path returned 401 Invalid authentication credentials.
claudeCodeFrameReview.nextAction: Retry a Claude Code two-frame design critique after CLI credentials are repaired; apply only reviewed, provider-light design deltas.

globalEvidenceRequiredBeforeSwitch: Vambah approves hosted Convex ownership, billing, backup, auth, env, and codegen window.
Generated API bindings are produced locally and reviewed against KINFLO_GENERATED_API_BINDINGS.
Read-only smokes pass before mutation-backed surfaces are switched.
Mutation smokes run in docs/convex-live-smoke-manifest.json order.
Rollback owner, fallback adapter path, and fixture restore criteria are documented.
Design QA confirms desktop and mobile states preserve hierarchy, spacing, accessibility, and no-overlap constraints.
Provider writes stay disabled until separate provider setup and client launch signoff pass.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Super admin must see tenant, site, and audit proof without cross-tenant ambiguity.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Return tenant/site/audit tables to fixtureKinfloShellAdapter if scope filtering or audit visibility fails.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Plan limits and override reasons must be visible before a client site can be created or sold.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Restore fixture plan and entitlement cards if usage math, overrides, or limits diverge.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Public preview must show a polished, client-specific first viewport on desktop and mobile before launch.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Keep /kinflo-sites preview routed to local fixtures if published/draft filtering or public-safe data fails.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Launch readiness must be a decision surface, not a passive checklist: owner, status, blockers, rollback, and proof must be scannable.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Restore fixture launch readiness if any launch gate is overstated or cross-tenant evidence leaks.

smokeEvidenceRequired: tenant/site scoped preferences require matching access
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Configurable shell controls must make density, default landing, filters, and site context clear without layout shift.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Return preference controls to local state if tenant/site permission checks or personal defaults fail.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Activation status must distinguish local readiness, hosted readiness, codegen, read-only smoke, and mutation smoke.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Keep activation smoke records labeled as smoke data and leave data mode on fixtures if seed output differs from manifest expectations.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Client site creation must show template fit, configuration profile, permissions, launch packet, invite posture, and rollback before execution.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Archive the smoke site, revoke pending invites, and return launch packets to fixtures if template creation or owner scope fails.

smokeEvidenceRequired: pipeline transition appends pipeline, journey, timeline, and audit events
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Lead intake and CRM status must be legible from first response through timeline, task, and stage movement.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Mark smoke leads and workflow data as test-only, restore fixture CRM tables, and keep outbound notifications paused.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Domain readiness must separate metadata review from DNS, SSL, and Vercel attachment execution.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Deactivate smoke domain metadata and keep DNS/SSL/Vercel attachment blocked if hostname or entitlement checks fail.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Provider setup must show env-key references, status, owner, and approval notes without exposing secret values.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Return integration readiness rows to fixtures and keep provider env activation blocked if settings expose secrets or scope incorrectly.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: Campaign screens must make draft, approval, consent, audience, and send-blocking status unmistakable.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Pause campaign records, restore fixture campaign review state, and keep email/SMS/automation sends blocked.

surfaceEvidenceMatrix.designGate: AI output must carry source summary, reviewer decision, publish target, and blocked provider-call status.
surfaceEvidenceMatrix.rollback: Keep generated output unpublished, return AI review rows to fixtures, and block AI provider calls until provenance smoke passes.
